potions.name: Instagram, no pictures
potions.description: Every photo and video on Instagram turns invisible. Captions and comments stay.

potions.name: Medium unlocked
potions.description: Lifts Medium's sign-in walls and pop-ups so you can keep reading. Member-only stories stay locked: their full text isn't on the page.

potions.name: Quora unlocked
potions.description: Lifts the log-in wall and the blur, and lets the page scroll again.

potions.name: Reddit unlocked
potions.description: Lifts “log in to keep reading” walls and lets the page scroll again.

potions.name: YouTube, no recommendations
potions.description: The home feed, the Up next sidebar and end-screen suggestions disappear. Search and Subscriptions still work.

potions.name: YouTube, no Shorts
potions.description: Hides the Shorts tab, Shorts shelves, and Shorts in feeds and search results.

potions.name: Break the wall
potions.description: Drink it on any page that says “log in to keep reading”. Lifts the wall, the blur and the scroll lock.

potions.name: Gray mode
potions.description: Drains the color out of any page. Less slot machine, more newspaper.

potions.name: Hide all images
potions.description: Every image becomes a blank tile. Hover one to peek.

potions.name: Hype detector
potions.description: Lights up buzzwords, so you can see how hard a page is selling.

potions.name: Night mode
potions.description: Turns any page dark by flipping its colors. Photos and videos stay normal.
potions.css:
html { filter: invert(1) hue-rotate(180deg) !important; background: #fff !important; }
img, video, canvas, iframe, svg image { filter: invert(1) hue-rotate(180deg) !important; }

potions.name: Unstick everything
potions.description: Sticky headers, floating bars and pinned pop-ups go back to being normal parts of the page.
